name: OnePlus 15 - OxygenOS 16
description: Factory package set of the OnePlus 15 running OxygenOS 16. Safety levels and notes were carried over from the original project and community research (UAD, XDA, DroidWin).
source: Package dump of a OnePlus 15 (OxygenOS 16, build BP2A.250605.015), originally maintained in the PowerShell TUI that predates this application. Descriptions and safety notes come from community research.

categories.name: 3rd-Party Preloads
categories.description: Preinstalled partner apps and installer stubs. Most of these are safe to remove and often reinstall themselves if left alone.

categories.name: Google Bloat
categories.description: Google apps and services that can be replaced or simply are not used. Read the CAUTION notes: some of them are tie-ins for core features.

categories.name: Microsoft / Link to Windows
categories.description: Phone Link integration. Keep these if you use Link to Windows on a PC.

categories.name: Android / AOSP
categories.description: Optional AOSP components: printing, accessibility extras, engineering tools and legacy providers.

categories.name: Qualcomm
categories.description: Qualcomm test frameworks, telemetry and legacy services. On a retail phone almost all of them are unused.

categories.name: OnePlus / Oplus Bloat
categories.description: OxygenOS apps, AI features, telemetry and system services. The largest group - CAUTION and RISKY entries here can remove real functionality.
